_comment: Shared fixture for show_ui card specs. Go (spec_test.go) validates every case and checks `valid` / `error_contains`. The web suite (GenerativeCard.test.tsx) renders every VALID card and asserts it draws without an error box, so a component the validator accepts is one the renderer can draw.
